title: The hypercube Ramsey number has linear order — part 5/8 (sections 08, 10, 11)
coverage:
I read all three files in my block line by line. I checked them against the cited statements: eq. (source-2)/Cor. initial-discrepancy, Lemma bias-purity, stabilization, balanced-profiles, conditional-avoidance (LLL comparison), scattered-moments, gated-posterior, height-selection (both radius regimes and the parameter inequalities), clock-sampling (θ0, A*, P*, B), and Def. limiting-bias-exponents / Prop. intermediate-bias-exclusion in Sec. 09.

SECTION 08
- Lemma asymmetric-purity: VERIFIED, Steps 1–12.
  - Step 1 trimming: exceptional-set sizes from source-2, since η ≤ η0/2 gives width ≤ n^{η0} and deviation 2n^{-η} ≥ n^{-η0}; α_x = 2^{-h}(1+o(1/s)) because τ < η.
  - Step 2 base gates: posterior-ratio bound via R'(Θ) ≥ N^{-h}e^{-n^{τ/2}}; filtering of the aggregate laws; Markov bound on L_g/Δ; the e^{-n^{2τ}} cutoff is o(A_g); 0.8A_g ≤ Z_g ≤ 1.2A_g.
  - Step 3 height parameters: ρ = .01 gives r ≤ d/4; D = 2 gives at most two levels per odd cell; crowd bound 2n^{τ/16} ≤ T.
  - Step 4 reference densities: internal factor e^{hn^β+n^{τ/2}}·1.1/.8; cross factor 1.1·2^h/(.8(1−Δ)) ≤ 2^{h+2}; the log-density total is ≤ 1.5δhs log n.
  - Step 5 Markov chains and list counting: δh/4 > 2C makes L_n^n ε0^{n/4} beat the cell count. The maximal-disjoint-family / eligibility argument holds. Scope radii check out.
  - Steps 6–7: the subdensity F_ξ a_ξ, the sum over lists ≤ 1, the M^a ≥ ε0 M switch, the H-truncation computation (exponent .003 − .005 < 0), and the mean recovery with ε0 L_n = o(1).
  - Step 8 miss bound Δ/(1−Δ).
  - Step 9: the selection weight λ·O(1/λ) uses the 3/λ bound uniformly over eligibility; E_raw B_g = O(K); both scattered-moment applications (f_grid L_B = o(1); f_res = e^{-Ω(n)} via H(.02) < log 2, L_U = e^{o(n)} because γ < 1).
  - Step 10: F_z ≤ .98^{-n} e^{.02 s log n · m} Q_v ≤ e^{.03n} Q_v (ms log n = o(n) since τ ≤ .01); alarm Markov; LLL degree O(n^4).
  - Steps 11–12: charge removals; disjoint radius-4 scopes; N max w_v ≤ e^{.07n+o(n)}; residual-near fraction × e^{.1n} → 0; clock-lemma hypotheses.
- Cor. asymmetric-discrepancy: VERIFIED. The reduction to β ≤ γ, the doubled budgets inside n^{β+}, n^{γ+}, the Markov trimming to defect e^{-n^{h*/2}}, and the sides-reversed application all hold.

SECTION 10
- Prop. full-dimensional-cluster-exclusion: VERIFIED.
  - Hamming-syndrome projection: H' preimages, multiplicities 2 or H', at most one singleton.
  - Height parameters, sublinear case: b = 140δ > b0 + 7ρ = 120δ; b0 > a > ζ + σ + (1−θ); T ≥ 2n^{140δ}.
  - Increment identity q(x) = E_tilt d(x; D|_J)^2 and the Jensen/aggregate bound 4ν/A(J). Width k(T+m) = n^{500δ} = o(n^{η0}). Codegree mean ≥ 1/4 + a, giving mean increment ≥ −log4 + .7a, then the Azuma deviation.
  - Test thresholds (source-4).
  - Tilt-restriction tail t_c^2 A(F_{-c})/A(F): e^{-.24ak}, e^{-.4k}, e^{-k|D|}; h_F ≥ 1/2; p_D ≤ 8e^{2k(T+m)} ν.
  - Mask minimax: cheap labels have ν-mass ≥ .9, prior cluster loss ≤ .2, cost ≤ 10(T+1)S.
  - Selection weights: (1/.99)^m gives N max p̂_b ≤ e^{.1m}.
  - Likelihood-ratio formula h_F^{-1}(A(F_{-c})/A(F))(D(F)/D(F_{-c}))^{2−j}, the j ≥ 2 and singleton bounds, and (source-5) using m = o(an), (m+T)log n = o(ak).
  - Posterior cap; the B-set exponent .02 − .01 log 2 + .0002a > 0; light mass c6·a; even cap e^{(log2−.01a)n}.
  - Cancellation for p̂^X; tag profiles via Kakutani; f_res·cap → 0.
  - Cluster column concentration, using e^x ≤ 1+(e−1)x and atom e^{-Ω(n^ζ)} since 500δ < ζ.
- Cor. eventual-cluster-absence: VERIFIED (routine stabilization).

SECTION 11
- Prop. linear-budget-jump-exclusion: VERIFIED.
  - Derivation of (source-6) from monotonicity of H_rev; H_L(.01,.01) = 0; the column trimming.
  - Slice tests via gated-posterior; widths ≤ .02n.
  - F_w ≤ e^{(log2−2g)kh} Q via log(1+4g) ≥ 4g − 8g^2; posterior cap with n^{.01} = o(gh); the T0 lower bound.
  - Tag-stage LLL: (4η)^{(n−h)/2}·N → 0 with η = 1e−8.
  - Caps of A_s, B_s: 2^n·.8^{d/2}·e^{o(n)}; E B_s ≤ K.
  - Tuple-stage LLL; clock hypotheses; even cap 2^n e^{-.4gh} with gh = n^{.09}; normalization by mass ≥ 1/2.
- Lemma compatible-balanced-profile: VERIFIED.
  - |m_x| discard via (source-6).
  - Clique witness: codegree (1+m+m'+K)/4 ≥ 1/4 + n^{-δ}, using b* = n^{-.95}.
  - High-degree-tag witness: L^2 projection argument; bounded independence number; Ramsey packing (s_c^{t0} ≪ e^{.03n}); aggregate O(1)π.
  - Closedness of the response graph for Kakutani.
- Lemma jump-outer-mass-tail: VERIFIED.
  - Φ_u expansion and the coverage cancellation.
  - One-free bound via offsets.
  - Two-free bound: t n^{-1.03} = n^{-.78} vs O(b*√t) = n^{-.825}.
  - E M_J^2 ≤ (Cb*)^r + small, so E|M_J| ≤ n^{-.4|J|} since .475 > .4.
  - Extension count: t0 = O(n^{2υ}) using δ = 4υ, log binom ≤ n^{.01+2υ} < n^{.03}.
  - Exponential-weight ranges; charge |B_R| max σ D_x^{-d} ≤ (2^n/N) e^{-.5gh+O(n^{.05})}.
- Cor. remaining-deep-regime: VERIFIED. This is logic only, and it relies on Prop. intermediate-bias-exclusion from Sec. 09, which is outside my block and was taken as given.

Nothing in the block went unchecked. The Sec. 09 proposition and the proofs of the Sec. 03 tools were taken as stated.
main_claim: Sec. 08: with the initial discrepancy (source-2), a balanced nearly-pure mixture is excluded when one side has width ≤ n^γ (γ<1) and the other ≤ n^β (β<τ/4). This gives asymmetric power discrepancy for every rational budget pair. Sec. 10: available full-dimensional cluster witnesses (codegree ≥ 1/4+n^{-δ}, atoms ≤ e^{-n^ζ}, widths ≤ n^δ) force a cube, so they are eventually absent. Sec. 11: H†≥1 in both orientations together with H_L†=0 in one forces a cube. Combined with Sec. 09, both linear exponents H_L† are ≥ 1, i.e. deep discrepancy n^{-1+ε} at budgets n^x, αn in both orientations.
sibling_notes: I re-derived and found consistent the numerical exponent margins most worth re-checking: Sec. 08 Step 10's ms·log n = o(n), which needs τ ≤ .01 (true since η ≤ .04); Sec. 10's posterior-tail coefficient .02 − .01 log2 > 0 and the requirement 500δ < ζ; Sec. 11's two-free contradiction n^{-.78} vs n^{-.825} and its use of δ = 4υ. Cor. remaining-deep-regime depends on Prop. intermediate-bias-exclusion (Sec. 09), and Prop. linear-budget-jump uses the Sec. 09 definitions of H, H_L, H†, H_L†, so the Sec. 09 reviewer should confirm that proposition. Sec. 13 cites Cor. eventual-cluster-absence at parameters (ζ, δ) with γ'a_C < δ < min(η0, ζ, 1)/2000. That matches the hypotheses as stated in Prop. full-dimensional-cluster-exclusion.
